safety_verdicts.content: Headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states the headache is still present during the consultation; generated facts do not explicitly state it is ongoing at the time of review.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the headache is still ongoing at the time of assessment is a key HPI element that influences urgency, differential (persistent vs resolved), and follow-up planning. Omission could lead a subsequent clinician to underestimate current symptom burden or mis-triage, though the overall harm is usually limited because onset/timing and severity are otherwise documented.
